children: Shetty brings nearly two decades of investment banking and real estate experience to the Board as the lubricant maker expands its domestic and international operations

GP Petroleums has appointed Rahul Arun Shetty as an Additional Director (Non-Executive, Independent) for a two-year term starting 21 September 2026. The appointment adds investment banking, real estate and capital markets experience to the Board as the company works to expand its IPOL lubricants business.

At GP Petroleums, Shetty will serve on the Audit Committee and Corporate Social Responsibility Committee. His appointment comes as the company continues to expand its manufacturing and distribution footprint for its IPOL portfolio across domestic and international markets.

Shetty has close to 20 years of experience across investment banking and real estate. He is Founder and Director of Optimus Investments, a London-headquartered firm involved in UK real estate transactions, asset management and capital raising for international investors since 2019.
Earlier in his career, Shetty worked in investment banking with Lehman Brothers, Nomura and Barclays. He also serves as a Non-Executive Independent Director on the board of Vedanta Power.

Arjun Verma, Executive Director and Chief Financial Officer, GP Petroleums, said Shetty’s experience in global investment banking and real estate would bring an additional perspective to capital allocation and the company’s plans outside India.
The appointment is subject to shareholder approval at a General Meeting or through a postal ballot, according to regulatory disclosures.

GP Petroleums manufactures and markets automotive and industrial lubricants under the IPOL brand. Its portfolio includes engine oils, greases and specialty lubricants for automotive, industrial and marine applications.
